question:
A question is given, followed by three statements labelled I, II and III. Identify which of the statements is/are sufficient to answer the question.

Question:

Who ranked first in the class?

Statements:

I. Sreeja ranked 2ⁿd.

II. Aman ranked one rank below Sreeja.

III. Rohit ranked better than Aman.

options.text: Each statement I, II and III alone is sufficient.
Statement I alone is sufficient, while Statement II alone is not sufficient.
Statement II alone is sufficient, while Statement III alone is not sufficient.
All statements I, II and III together are sufficient.
